_source: Player.cs constants (RECONSTRUCTION 4.2), in the original's own units: pixels, pixels per second, and per frame where the original added a figure each frame. Morris, Leo and Shanoa share them.

spawn._about: SceneManager.LoadContent creates two players; Reset (R) puts every player back at the reset position (4.9: both go to 500,100 in the original).

abilities._about: AbilityList.cs (4.1). Run, Slide, SinkInWater and BulletTime are never read in the original.

kneel._about: Owner decision 2026-10-23 (BIBLE defect 3, built by U.VAN-T23): releasing the kneel stands the character up. The original never did.

wallJump._about: Owner decision 2026-10-23 (BIBLE defect 6, built by U.VAN-T24): a wall jump pushes the character off the wall at once. The original only climbed along it (4.7). pushSpeed is a data slot in pixels per second away from the wall; U.VAN-T24 tunes it in play, 200 (the run cap) is a starting value.
